observedMismatch: The Demo footer uses the right independent assets but arranges them as a pale diagonal poster field; the official source uses a different layered composition and a scroll-triggered reveal/state swap.
userFeedback: The Luffy footer background composition is wrong and the source image is dynamic.
whyOldGatePassed: Evidence proved asset presence and two late screenshots but did not freeze the complete default/transition/settled geometry and state swap.
Interpreter allowed a broad responsive reconstruction without sufficiently bounding the relative placement and crop of the focal character, logo, catch and cards.
Demo self-check counted seven loaded assets and bounded duration but did not compare the composite composition frame-by-frame.
Blind QA checked layer existence, not the source-to-demo spatial and temporal sequence.
correctiveAction: Recapture the official Footer before entry, during reveal and after settling with per-layer geometry/computed state, then rebuild and re-QA the Demo footer.
preventiveAction: For high-salience animated organisms require default/transition/settled screenshots, per-layer normalized regions, state/class changes and source/demo spatial-temporal comparison; asset-count checks alone cannot pass.
